app.name: Tambat
app.headline: Prove that one person holds a Bitcoin Cash wallet and a Nostr key.
app.sub: Sign with both keys, publish the proof to Nostr relays, and let anyone check it without trusting this site.

how.title: How it works
how.one: Your Nostr key publishes a NIP-39 identity event that names your BCH address.
how.two: Your BCH wallet signs a message naming your npub, so neither key can claim the other alone.
how.three: Anyone fetches the event from relays and checks both signatures on their own device.

nostr.extensionHelp: NIP-07, for example Alby or nos2x.

nostr.bunkerHelp: NIP-46. Paste the bunker address from your signer app.
nostr.demoHelp: A throwaway key made in this tab. It never leaves your browser and is gone when you close the tab.

lookup.title: Look up an identity
lookup.help: Enter an npub or a BCH address. Your browser asks the relays directly and checks every result itself.
lookup.label: npub or BCH address
lookup.none: No binding was found on the relays.
lookup.inputError: Enter an npub, a 64-character hex key or a BCH address with its prefix.
lookup.noLink: This key has no current BCH link. Its newest identity event, published {date}, names no BCH address.

reasons.event_malformed: This is not a well-formed Nostr event.
reasons.wrong_kind: The event is kind {kind}; a binding is kind {expected}.
reasons.id_mismatch: The event id does not match its contents, so it was changed after signing.
reasons.nostr_sig_invalid: The Nostr signature does not match this key.
reasons.no_relay_results: Not checked yet; look the key up to compare with the relays.
reasons.replaced: A newer event from the same key replaces this one.
reasons.signature_unreadable: The BCH signature cannot be read. Copy the whole signed message from your wallet.
reasons.address_invalid: The address is not a valid P2PKH CashAddr with its network prefix.
reasons.no_public_key: Skipped because no key could be read from the BCH signature.
reasons.wrong_signer: The signature was not made by the key of {address} for {npub}.
reasons.wrong_network: The address is on {prefix}; this site expects {network}.
reasons.same_key: The BCH key and the Nostr key are the same key. Use separate keys.

demo.help: This page stands for any other app. Its server sends a one-time challenge, checks your signed answer, then fetches your binding from the relays itself.
demo.alsoBch: Also sign the challenge with my BCH key
demo.noAddress: No verified BCH address for this key yet.
demo.bchSigned: Your BCH key also signed this sign-in.

pay.title: Pay an identity
pay.help: Enter an npub. The address comes from a binding your browser verifies, and your own wallet sends the payment.
pay.label: npub
pay.none: This key has no verified BCH address.
pay.amountFormat: Enter the amount in BCH with at most 8 decimals, for example 0.001.
pay.amountZero: The amount must be more than zero.

footer.trust: Keys stay in your browser and wallet. The server only issues sign-in challenges.
